svg.title: Liar's Tide: Sailor's tattoo flash
svg.desc: Liar's Tide (1D): a bluffing dice game at a tavern table, drawn as a sailor's tattoo flash. Alexi's horn cup is lifted to show his five tide dice; the shared tide die sits face up in the middle; the bid on the banner claims four Lanterns. A circling arrow marks his secret stir of the cup, and the row of sailors' eyes turning red shows suspicion rising toward being caught.
